visual.name: GrowthStackedChart
visual.description: Grouped stacked bar chart with segment percentage/value labels, growth rate annotations and connecting lines. Ideal for year-over-year comparison across categories.

en-US.Visual_LandingDescription: Add Category, Sub-Category, Stack Segment and Value fields to build a grouped stacked bar chart with growth annotations.
en-US.Visual_AriaDescription: Grouped stacked bar chart with growth annotations

zh-CN.Visual_LandingDescription: 请添加类别、子类别、堆叠分段和值字段，以生成带增长率标注的分组堆叠条形图。
zh-CN.Visual_AriaDescription: 带增长率标注的分组堆叠条形图

dataRoles.name: group
dataRoles.description: Primary category shown on X-axis (e.g., region, product line, department)

dataRoles.name: year
dataRoles.description: Secondary category compared side-by-side within each group (e.g., year, quarter, scenario)

dataRoles.name: location
dataRoles.description: Breakdown dimension stacked within each bar (e.g., province, product, team)

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Additional measures shown in the tooltip

minSegmentHeight.description: Hide label when segment is smaller than this

labelColor.description: Color of the growth percentage text

lineColor.description: Color of the connecting line between bars

lineGap.description: Vertical spacing between bar totals and the connecting line
